skills.name: playwright-mcp
skills.purpose: WRITE-heavy (acts on live web pages). Config observed: {"mcpServers":{"playwright":{"command":"npx","args":["@playwright/mcp@latest"]}}}. No API token required; its power comes from the browser profile it drives — by default it uses a persistent profile, so it inherits whatever sessions/cookies that profile holds. Flags observed: --isolated (in-memory profile, discarded on close), --headless, --browser (chrome/firefox/webkit/msedge), --allowed-origins and --blocked-origins (semicolon-separated), --storage-state, --caps (vision, pdf, devtools, network, storage, testing). skills.purpose: READ+WRITE (write by default). Docs name prompt injection as "the primary attack vector unique to LLMs" (example: a support ticket containing injected SQL) and recommend read-only mode, project scoping, feature groups, database branches, connecting to production only when required, and keeping manual per-tool approval.
